faq.q: What is the origin of Ghafur?
faq.a: Ghafur is associated with Arabic. Ghafur is a transliteration of Arabic غفور (Ghafūr) 'most forgiving'. The same word appears in this batch as ghafoor and in the previous batch as gafoor.
Yes — the underlying form غفور is Arabic.
Ghafur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
